mutants.name: the library frame is never drawn
expectRed: a view that draws no frame is drawn inside the library frame: a titled header, a grab bar and a phone frame

mutants.name: the frame is drawn even when the view claimed one
expectRed: a view that draws only a PanelFrame counts as self-framed: no library header, no second frame, one mount

mutants.name: the opt-out is ignored
expectRed: frame: 'none' draws a bare view as it is, mounted once with no frame

mutants.name: the verdict is not remembered for the template
expectRed: a bare view mounts again once when the frame is drawn around it; the next panel of the same template mounts once

mutants.name: a late claim does not release the library frame
expectRed: a view that renders nothing at first and draws a Panel later releases the library frame

mutants.name: Panel does not claim
expectRed: a view that draws only a Panel, or a PanelFrame with its footer off, counts as self-framed too

mutants.name: PanelFrame does not claim
expectRed: a view that draws only a Panel, or a PanelFrame with its footer off, counts as self-framed too

mutants.name: PanelFooter does not claim
expectRed: footer={false} on the frame draws none, and PanelFooter in a view draws it

mutants.name: the library header has no fallback title
expectRed: a bare view with no title shows the untitled label, and the title the panel carries once it has one

mutants.name: the library frame has no drag-to-close
expectRed: a real pointer drag down on the grab bar closes a bare panel

mutants.name: the library frame cannot reorder
expectRed: a real pointer drag sideways on the grab bar moves a bare panel past its neighbour

mutants.name: the library frame ignores the slot size
expectRed: at two slots the library frame is as wide as its slot

mutants.name: the frame setting is not read from the slot
expectRed: frame: 'none' draws a bare view as it is, mounted once with no frame

mutants.name: frame defaults to none
expectRed: a view that draws no frame is drawn inside the library frame: a titled header, a grab bar and a phone frame
